data.body:
LANDED as change 1065, merged to main (commit 2ee387d80 in my rebased worktree).

Verified before push: the diff is exactly two hunks in _optionality.yml (the file header comment, which enumerated the now-deleted check, plus the import-linter job removal); clean-core-wheel, per-extra and union were byte-identical. The repaid guard (test_optionality_suite_still_runs_in_the_default_selection) was proven RED two ways before landing — a file-level pytestmark dropped collection to 2/9 and tripped the 'collects NOTHING' assertion, and a single-test decorator tripped the exact-count assertion at 8 — then GREEN once restored.

Follow-up found while rebasing ad63 on top of this: infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json still carried the check context 'import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)' for the job this change deleted. That snapshot is not the live ruleset (Terraform gerrit-mirror-lock-main declares no required_status_checks) but it IS POSTed back by infra/github/rollback-mirror-lock.sh, so a stale entry would make an emergency rollback demand a check that can no longer exist. Removed as part of change 1066, which was already editing that file to drop the per-extra/union contexts.
